emma (docs): Heads-up: found a docs vs API mismatch for POST /v1/rerank. OpenAPI currently shows responses.scores as [number], but runtime is returning objects: [{id,score,score_normalized}]. I'll open a PR to correct the API ref, add migration notes, and update Ruby + Go snippets.
josh (sdk-ruby): Oh — Ruby SDK tests currently assert Array<Float>. That will break. We should add a compatibility layer in sdk-ruby to keep returning floats for legacy callers and provide a new `detailed_scores` accessor.
priya (api): Runtime now includes score_normalized (0-1) for downstream ranking stability, and we added id to tie scores back to candidates. This was rolled out behind a flag for internal teams. Plan: update OpenAPI response schema to array of objects and mark old 'scores' shape as deprecated in docs.
emma (docs): I'll update the example response and add both canonical examples: legacy flat array (legacy example) and new object array (recommended). Also adding a short note: "Prefer score_normalized for comparability across models."
josh (sdk-ruby): I'll implement a shim in SDK v0.9 that: if response element is number -> map to [{id: idx, score: number, score_normalized: null}], else expose new structure via `result.detailed_scores`. Will add deprecation warning in verbose.
priya (api): Also change request body docs: our OpenAPI mistakenly named the param `candidates_list` in examples; canonical name is `candidates`. Please update examples and body schema to match.
emma (docs): Copy that. I'll fix examples (curl, ruby, go), OpenAPI snippet, and update the top-level note in rerank reference: "Requests should include candidates (array) and query (string)".
marco (eng-sre): Small ops note: the new response shape landed on staging; we plan to switch the flag to true for prod on Monday 04:00-05:00 UTC during a quiet window. Coordinate SDK release and docs merge before that.
qa-bot: QA checklist: add integration test asserting both shapes accepted by clients; add a docs snippet showing how to parse both kinds.
josh (sdk-ruby): Will open SDK PR with shim + unit tests today and ping emma to mirror examples. Also adding changelog entry: "Rerank: response shape extended with score objects; SDKs to provide compatibility mapping."
emma (docs): Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9999 (WIP). I'll include: 1) updated OpenAPI snippet 2) curl + ruby + go examples 3) migration guide w/ code samples showing old->new parsing.
priya (api): When you update OpenAPI, add x-deprecation on the old example and an examples section showing object and array. Also add response note: "routing metadata unaffected".
emma (docs): Will do. Requesting review from @josh and @priya before merge. Marco, please confirm prod flip timing in #eng once scheduled.
marco (eng-sre): Confirmed Monday 04:00 UTC. I'll post deployment announcement.
josh (sdk-ruby): PR will target v0.9.0 and be ready Friday. I'll include a tiny snippet for README showing preferred new accessors.
emma (docs): Thanks all. After merge I'll post a short note in #product and #support so integrators know to expect the normalized scores field.
